cases.translation: He built a house for the name of the Lord.
cases.explain: Nominative case - subject of the sentence

cases.translation: The stones were made from the earth.
King Solomon ruled over the Israelites.
cases.explain: Nominative case - subject of the sentence

cases.translation: The Lord fulfilled the promise with his hand.
cases.explain: Instrumental case indicates the means by which an action is performed

cases.translation: Solomon gave the cities to Hiram.
cases.explain: After the verb 'отдать' (to give), the object is in accusative case

cases.sentence: Они положили вещи в ___ дома Господа.
cases.translation: They put the things in the treasury of the Lord's house.
You sit on the throne of Israel.
cases.explain: Preposition 'на' with locative case indicates location

reading.ru: Однако на то, чтобы завершить строительство своего дворца, у Соломона ушло 13 лет.
reading.question: How many years did Solomon spend building his palace?
reading.explain: The text states that Solomon spent 13 years to complete the construction of his palace.

reading.ru: Он построил дворец, который назвал дворцом ливанского леса.
reading.question: What did Solomon call the palace he built?
reading.explain: The text explicitly says Solomon called his palace the 'palace of the Lebanon Forest'.

reading.ru: С четырьмя рядами кедровых колонн, поддерживающих кедровые балки.
reading.question: What material were the columns and beams made from?
reading.explain: The text describes cedar columns supporting cedar beams.

reading.ru: Царь Соломон пригласил и принял Херама из Тира, сына вдовы из рода Нефалима.
reading.question: Who was Hiram?
reading.explain: The text says Solomon invited and received Hiram from Tyre, who was a master craftsman in bronze.

reading.ru: Море было в ладонь толщиной, а его край был как край чаши, как цветок лилии.
reading.question: What was the shape of the molten sea's brim like?
reading.explain: The text describes the edge of the molten sea as being like the edge of a cup, like the flower of a lily.

reading.ru: Море стояло на двенадцати быках, три из которых смотрели на север, три — на запад, три — на юг и три — на восток.
reading.question: How many oxen supported the molten sea and in which directions did they face?
reading.explain: The text states the sea stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, three west, three south, and three east.
